title: The Forgotten Experiment
description: Search two abandoned laboratory rooms, collect and equip tools, solve layered evidence puzzles, and unlock Dr. Elias Vale's experiment.

prompt.objective: Build a first-person lab escape room with inventory tools, evidence, layered puzzles, hints, and an unlockable exit.

mintAssets.brief: Worn lab furniture, machinery, terminals, and locks.
Cryogenic pod, optics array, and containment console.

experience: Choose a room, look or walk around, and examine lab objects.
Collect evidence and solve code, sequence, and logic puzzles.
Track code digits, offer hints, and complete an escape ending.
prompt.visualDirection: Grimy enamel, brushed steel, red emergency light, cyan displays, and a restrained archive HUD.

thumbnail.alt: A worn containment machine stands in an abandoned laboratory beneath a classified experiment HUD.
